input.subject: English
input.objective: The child says a word that rhymes with a word given.

options.name: Blending & reading CVC words
options.what: Reads CVC words with short vowels; blends CVC words; blends vowels and consonants; reads 3+ letter words using sounds.

options.name: Rhymes & songs: joins in and recites
options.what: Repeats actions and overheard words in rhymes; listens to rhymes in all languages; sings along and sings out loud a known rhyme/song.

options.name: Spelling & dictation
options.what: Listens and spells 3-letter words; dictation phonetically and spelling building (CVC and beyond).

options.name: Verb forms & suffix spelling rules
options.what: Uses -ing and -ed verb forms appropriately; adds -es / -ed / -ing to words ending in y.

options.name: Rhyming words
options.what: Understands rhyming words.

options.name: Syllables & polysyllabic words
options.what: Understanding of syllable and polysyllabic rules (open/closed syllables; 2-3 syllable words).

options.name: Consonant digraphs & silent-letter spellings
options.what: Recognises digraphs (ck, ll, sh, ch, ff, zz) in words and books; ch saying /sh/ and /k/; dge/ge saying /j/; gn/kn saying /n/.

options.name: Adjacent consonants (CCVC/CVCC)
options.what: Understanding of CVCC and CCVC words; adjacent consonants.

options.name: Counting objects with 1:1 correspondence
options.what: Understands 1-1 correspondence; accurately counts items to 10, 20, 30; counts people in a room; counts objects to 100.

options.name: Verbal counting range (forward)
options.what: Counts verbally beyond 10, to 20, to/beyond 50.

options.name: Backward counting
options.what: Counts backward 10 to 1, 20 to 1, 30 to 1.

options.name: Sorting, matching & classifying
options.what: Sorts shapes and colours; matches same objects; pairing; odd man out; groups/ungroups by characteristics; introduction to sets.

options.name: Number recognition range
options.what: Recognises numbers 1-20, then numbers to 150, to 1000.

options.name: Finger numbers to 10
options.what: Shows finger numbers to 10.

options.name: Before / after / missing numbers
options.what: Tells after/before numbers in a sequence; before, after and missing numbers to 20; number sequences.

options.name: Number names
options.what: Number names 1-10, 11-20, 21-30; up to 100; 4-digit number names.

input.subject: English
input.objective: The child reads a short passage aloud and answers a question about it.

options.name: Literal comprehension & recall
options.what: Answers factual questions about the text; passage comprehension; recalls information from the text.

options.name: Evaluative & inferential comprehension
options.what: Answers evaluative, extrapolative and value-based questions.

options.name: Blending & reading CVC words
options.what: Reads CVC words with short vowels; blends CVC words; blends vowels and consonants; reads 3+ letter words using sounds.

options.name: Story structure & text features
options.what: Beginning, middle and end of a story; features like commands, statements, rhyme and questions in a poem.

options.name: Text types & genres
options.what: Fiction vs non-fiction; recount text; genres (fantasy, mystery, poetry); novel, short story, story.

options.name: Listens & responds to name, instructions, questions
options.what: Responds to own name; follows simple then 2-step instructions; listens and responds to directions and questions.

options.name: Sight words & tricky words
options.what: Reads two-letter sight words; understanding of sight words; tricky words lists.

options.name: Book handling & print concepts
options.what: Reads books front to back, page by page; left-to-right word reading; 1:1 finger-point matching; page numbers, front/back cover, title page.
